**Build passes again.** Exit code is 0.

Two real bugs hid in the noise. Both came from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Accept both keys |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 `WARN` lines are still there. All are deprecation notes. None break the build.

Next: clean up `src/legacy` for `DEP0142` and `DEP0198`.
